card.defaultLabel: Fallback name for a linked folder whose path has no final segment
card.blockedLink: Marks a symlink the app refuses to follow, not a broken hyperlink

health.available: The linked folder can be read right now
health.missing: The linked folder is no longer at its recorded path
health.unreadable: The linked folder exists but cannot be read

linked.readOnly: Badge saying Oleafly only reads the linked folder and never writes to it
linked.blockedLink: Marks a symlink the app refuses to follow, not a broken hyperlink

outputs.review: Button that opens the review tab for a finished task

status.queued: A research task that has not started yet
status.running: A research task that is executing now
status.cancelled: A research task the user stopped before it finished
status.planReady: Task status: the agent wrote its plan and waits for the user to approve it.

relative.justNow: Timestamp for an event less than a minute old

panel.filterAll: Task list filter showing every task
panel.filterRunning: Task list filter showing running and queued tasks
panel.filterReview: Task list filter showing tasks waiting for review
panel.filterDone: Task list filter showing finished, failed and cancelled tasks
panel.dismiss: Closes an error banner without retrying

composer.unavailable: Marks an agent the user cannot pick right now
composer.dependencyStatus: Shows a dependency task's status in parentheses after its title
composer.replaceText: Question under the Start from list in the new task dialog, shown when the user picked a starter after typing their own title or instructions
composer.keepText: Button answering that question: keep what the user typed
composer.replaceConfirm: Button answering that question: replace it with the starter's text

approvals.detailCommand: Label above the whole command a task asks to run, in the approval request
approvals.detailRun: Label above the details of a run a task asks to start (its name, command and variable names), in the approval request
approvals.detailMcp: Label above the arguments a task wants to pass to a tool, in the approval request
approvals.loadFailed: Error in the banner of requests waiting for approval, shown with a Retry button when the list could not be read

settings.networkHint: Line under the switch that lets commands run by research tasks reach the internet by default
settings.loadFailed: Error at the top of Settings, Research when the saved settings could not be read; a Retry button follows
settings.sectionName: Name of the Research settings card, used in the Reset to defaults button text
settings.resetConfirm: Confirmation text for resetting the Research settings card. The compute targets and background tasks cards are separate and are not reset

detail.waiting: Button label while a start request is still in flight
detail.preview: Loads the diff for one changed file
detail.changedSince: The file changed in the project after the task started
detail.mergesOnApply: Calm note under one changed file in a shared project. The file was edited after the task started, and applying merges the task's changes with those edits instead of refusing
detail.changeAdded: A file the task created, shown lowercase and capitalized by CSS
detail.changeModified: A file the task edited, shown lowercase and capitalized by CSS
detail.changeDeleted: A file the task removed, shown lowercase and capitalized by CSS
detail.unknownTokens: Shown instead of a token count the runtime did not report
detail.isolationWorktree: The task ran in a separate Git worktree
detail.isolationStaged: The task ran in a copied staging folder
detail.activityGap_one: Note in a task's Activity tab, between the first saved items and the newest live ones. {{count}} is how many items in between have not been loaded yet (here, one); a Load more button follows
detail.activityGap_other: Note in a task's Activity tab, between the first saved items and the newest live ones. {{count}} is how many items in between have not been loaded yet; a Load more button follows
detail.activityMore: The same note when the number of missing items is not known
detail.keepRunningDesktopApps: Shown under the disabled Keep running when Oleafly is closed checkbox of a task that uses desktop apps

progress.costUsed: Money spent on the model so far and the task's limit. Both amounts arrive already formatted as US dollars, such as $1.20, so do not add a currency sign.
progress.costSpent: Money spent on the model so far when the task has no limit. {{used}} arrives already formatted as US dollars, such as $1.20.
progress.ledgerCapped: Note above a task's results table when it holds only the newest rows. {{limit}} is the number of rows shown

brief.invalidStart: Error under the Start at field of a research task when the time is in the past or more than 30 days ahead
brief.invalidStartFormat: Error under the Start at field when the typed text is not a date and time. {{example}} is a sample such as 2026-10-24T14:30, written with the T between date and time
brief.startAtFormat: Hint under the Start at field in a window that shows it as a plain text box. {{example}} is a sample such as 2026-10-24T14:30, written with the T between date and time
brief.problemHidden: Error shown while the Brief section of the new task dialog is folded and one of its options is wrong. Brief is that section's title

tools.back: Returns from a tool page to the project library

category.converters: Tools that convert one document format into another
category.write: Writing tools, used as a verb

generators.source: Uppercase heading above the source controls
generators.instructions: Uppercase heading above optional writing instructions
generators.taskFooter: Explains that Generate opens the assistant and sends the visible prompt

symbols.statusUnavailable: The bundled symbol reference failed to load
symbols.visibleLimit: Explains that only the first part of a large result set is rendered

converter.source: Badge for editable source text, not a research citation source
converter.bundle: Badge for an archive containing multiple converted files
converter.runsOnDevice: Privacy note saying the conversion is local
converter.downloadsFromArxiv: Network disclosure for the arXiv ID workflow
converter.pageRange: Label of a text field under a chosen scanned PDF in the PDF to Markdown and PDF to Typst converters; the user types which pages to transcribe
converter.pageRangePlaceholder: Placeholder of that field; empty means every page
converter.pageRangeInvalid: Shown under that field when the text is not a page number or a range like 1-50

references.fieldContainerTitle: Generic journal, book or proceedings container title
references.reference: A full bibliography entry, contrasted with an in-text citation
references.inText: A short citation placed inside prose
references.localEditing: Badge saying edits and formatting happen on this device
references.styleCount: Number of citation styles available for comparison
references.savedBibliography: {{name}} is the file name the user saved the bibliography as, for example references.bib

stats.tabInterval: Short tab label for the confidence interval calculator
stats.openPopulation: An effectively unlimited population for sample size planning
stats.finitePopulation: A population with a specified total size
stats.wilsonHalfWidth: Half-width of a Wilson score interval
stats.criticalValue: Label for the critical t or z value used in the interval

equation.inline: Renders the equation inside a line of text
equation.display: Renders the equation on its own centered line
equation.sourceHeading: Uppercase heading over the LaTeX input pane
equation.examples: Uppercase heading over the example equation buttons
equation.previewHeading: Uppercase heading over the rendered equation pane

bibtex.looksGood: Shown when a BibTeX entry has no findings
bibtex.examples: Uppercase heading over the sample .bib buttons

table.preview: Heading over the rendered table preview

review.friendly: Review tone that leads with strengths
review.fire: Review tone that stresses the paper's claims

labSearch.works: Number of publications an institution has
labSearch.citations: Number of times an institution's work was cited

literature.openSource: Lowercase tagline meaning the indexes are openly available
literature.available: The citation database can be searched now
literature.paused: The citation database is temporarily unavailable
literature.pausedTag: Lowercase tag on a disabled source chip
literature.openAccess: Badge on a record whose full text is freely available
literature.filters: Opens the year and open access filters

citationScan.for: Uppercase heading over the argument for citing a paper
citationScan.against: Uppercase heading over the argument against citing a paper
citationScan.forAgainst: Toggle that reveals the for and against reasoning
citationScan.query: Shows the search query derived from a paragraph

items.buildFailed: Shown in the evidence checklist when the task's workspace does not compile. {{errors}} is a number of errors.
items.numbersMismatch: A number in the manuscript differs from the metric recorded for the run it cites. {{value}} is the printed number, {{run}} a run id such as r002, {{recorded}} the recorded value.

converterModel.automatic: Model menu entry that lets Oleafly choose the best installed Ollama model
converterModel.sentTo: Privacy notice: the images go to this AI provider's servers
converterModel.scansSentTo: Privacy notice: the images go to this AI provider's servers
converterModel.sentToHost: Privacy notice: images go to an Ollama server on another computer, named by host and port
converterModel.scansSentToHost: Privacy notice: images go to an Ollama server on another computer, named by host and port
converterModel.pdfSentToMathpix: Privacy notice: Mathpix receives the whole PDF file, even when only some pages are converted
converterModel.transcribingHosted: Progress message while an image is uploaded to an AI provider. {{provider}} is the provider name
converterModel.estimateCost_one: {{cost}} is a formatted US dollar amount such as $0.42. {{model}} is an AI model name
converterModel.estimateCost_other: {{cost}} is a formatted US dollar amount such as $0.42. {{model}} is an AI model name
converterModel.estimateUnknown_one: Shown when the provider's prices are unknown, so no cost is given
converterModel.estimateUnknown_other: Shown when the provider's prices are unknown, so no cost is given
converterModel.transcribedWith: {{model}} is the AI model name that read the scanned pages, such as glm-ocr
converterModel.sentBadge: Header badge after a hosted provider transcribed a scanned PDF

targets.local: The user's own machine as a place to run experiments
targets.test: Button: run the connection checks for one target (verb)
targets.forgetHostKey: Removes the key from Oleafly's own list only
targets.reviewHostKey: Button on a run target whose connection test stopped to ask about the host's key. It brings that question back
targets.removeConfirm: Confirmation text for removing a run target. Tasks that have not started and use it will fail when they start
targets.perTaskSpace: A Cua Space created for each task, deleted with the task

import.skipped: Error in the SSH import dialog when some hosts were added and others were not. {{hosts}} is a list of host names, {{reason}} is the first error

kind.cuaSpace: Product name: Cua is a tool, a Space is its sandbox; keep both

notes.outputs: Keep runs/<run>/outputs as written; it is a folder path

form.addTitle: kind is one of the compute.kind values
form.prelude: Shell commands Oleafly runs on the remote machine before each run
form.qos: Slurm quality of service, keep as is
form.gpuFlag: The choices are literal Slurm flags and are not translated

test.warn: Status of one check that passed with a problem worth reading

sandbox.windowsDescription: AppContainer is a Windows term; keep it

brief.runsOn: target is a user@host:port or a Space name
brief.loadFailed: Error under Where runs happen in the new task dialog when the saved run targets could not be read; a Retry button follows

badge.background: Short badge on a research task. The background helper, a small Oleafly process that keeps tasks running after the app closes, runs this task.
badge.backgroundHint: Tooltip on the In background badge. The helper is a separate Oleafly process; the task comes back to the app window after the step it is on.
badge.movingBack: Short badge on a research task: Oleafly asked the background helper to return this task to the app.
badge.movingBackHint: Tooltip on the Moving back badge.

backgroundHelper.earlierActivity: Link button in a task's activity tab. It loads what the task did in its earlier runs, before it moved between the app and the background helper or resumed.
backgroundHelper.earlierTruncated: Note under one earlier run in a task's activity tab when the run has more items than were loaded. {{limit}} is the number of items shown
backgroundHelper.keepRunningFailed: Error toast after the Keep running when Oleafly is closed checkbox could not be changed.

converterErrors.pdfTooManyPages: Error shown in place of the cost confirmation when a scanned PDF has more pages than one run transcribes. {{pages}} is the page count, {{limit}} is the most pages per run (50)
converterErrors.outputLimit: Error shown when the AI model stopped writing because it hit its output limit, so a scanned page or image was only partly transcribed
